text: Take a breath, just as you are.
Maybe today was a day of measuring.
You are here. That is enough.
Let your shoulders drop. Let your jaw soften.
Notice the soft rhythm of your breath.
There is a place inside of you where you are already whole.
This is not something you chase, it's something you tune into.
Imagine now a soft golden warmth glowing in your chest.
This is the frequency of enough.
You don't have to earn it.
Let these words settle gently, like a hand resting over your heart.
You can return to it any time you choose.
